svg.title: Why a fork cannot be witnessed
svg.desc: Main branch and fork share the first 1000 entries; the fork inserts a rogue certificate after them. Every witness already cosigned main at 1500. A fork checkpoint of the same size has a different root, which the witness refuses (422). A bigger fork has no consistency proof from main at 1500 (422). Only a witness that never saw main can be fooled.

text.tspan: main: cosigned at 1500 by a, b, c
once a witness has seen one branch, it can only ever sign that branch's future.
the attack needs witnesses that never saw it: partition them, or own them.
